title: Looking beneath the royal city
text: Ahar Museum introduces a past that is different from the familiar palace story. Pottery, sculpture and other archaeological material draw attention to the communities and practices that preceded the city’s better-known monuments. Read the labels slowly: everyday objects can explain how people worked, worshipped and lived across different periods.
